spans.text: Unit 4: Variables in programming
3 From the Variables group, add the set () to () block. Select Number 1 from the dropdown menu.
4 From the Sensing group, add the answer block to the 2nd part as shown below.
when this sprite clicked
ask  What is the first number?  and wait
set  Number 1 ▾  to  answer
5 Add another ask () and wait block. Type What is the second number?
6 Set the variable Number 2 to the data in the answer block.
7 Set the variable Result to subtract Number 2 from Number 1. The subtraction block is found in the Operators group.
8 From the looks group, add the say () for () seconds block.
9 Go to the Operators group and add the join block to the first part of the say () for () seconds block. Change the word apple to Result =. Replace the word banana with the variable Result.
The final code is:
when this sprite clicked
ask  What is the first number?  and wait
set  Number 1 ▾  to  answer
ask  What is the second number?  and wait
set  Number 2 ▾  to  answer
set  Result ▾  to  Number 1 [operador ilegible] Number 2
say  join  Result =  Result  for  2  seconds
10 Test your code. Click the Green Flag. You will notice the variables you created are set to 0.

11 Click on Sam. Sam will ask you what is the first number? Enter the number 10. Sam will then ask you what is the second number? Enter the number 4. Sam will then subtract both numbers and give you the result as 6.
Number 1  0
Number 2  0
Results  0
Number 1  10
Number 2  4
Results  6
The variables are located on the top left hand of the screen. It shows the current values that are stored in each variable.
